claims.head: Nylander gets company tonight
claims.call: The Blue Jackets’ L3 (Coyle, Olivier and Sillinger) spends at least 57% of its 5-on-5 time against the Maple Leafs’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Blue Jackets keep sending Coyle’s line (Coyle, Olivier and Sillinger) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Rick Bowness has been using this group as a checking line on the other team’s top line. Tonight the Maple Leafs’ first line is Nylander, Roslovic and Matthews.
claims.nums: At home: 57% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against first lines, about 31% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Rick Bowness likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Maple Leafs’ first line.

notes.text: Chris Tanev is out week to week (upper body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Darren Raddysh has taken his spot beside Jake McCabe.
John Tavares is out week to week (lower body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Marshall Rifai was added to the roster on Oct 12.
Ivan Provorov is on injured reserve (lower body injury) and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. Zach Werenski has taken his spot beside Denton Mateychuk.

CBJ.head: The Blue Jackets should have the upper hand
CBJ.body: Columbus has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, has home-ice advantage and gets Andrae back, while Toronto will be without Tavares. The Maple Leafs’ way back in is a power play that gets going.
